macros.name: newpagecolor
macros.doc: \newpagecolor{<some color >} will execute \pagecolor{some color} and remember the page color used before.

macros.name: thepagecolor
macros.doc: This LaTeX package provides the command \thepagecolor, which gives the current page (background) color, i. e. the argument used with the most recent call of \pagecolor{...}.

macros.name: thepagecolornone
macros.doc: The command \thepagecolornone gives the same color as \thepagecolor, except when the page background color is “none”.
